parent_readback.body:
Stable-0 is released and Issue#1 remains closed. D-021 scopes the next step toward PAL accepting work without the user managing internal tasks.

Deliver natural Japanese local-draft request recognition plus safe correction/cancel targeting. No content-missing clarification feature, new task/tool, memory overhaul, always-on provider, external sending, schedule, payment or public exposure.

Acceptance: all N1-01–08 in ACCEPTANCE.md PASS with actual evidence, one direct human evaluation, final full suite/version/limitations audit and private release. All currently NOT_RUN. Existing S0/F0 safety/functional meaning and D-020 boundaries remain. Historical72h quotas remain nonrequired.

Next action: freeze ingress corpus and reviewer-held-out cases, then official SWE-2 High review concrete implementation contracts before substantial code. Independent work proceeds while genuinely human-dependent work waits in the ongoing human-judgment thread.

This issue organizes authorized next scope; no implementation is claimed by its creation.

Ordered work:
- [ ] #3 — ingress intent and independent corpus
- [ ] #4 — correction/cancel target binding and recovery
- [ ] #5 — real UI, authentic human evaluation and release audit

Source of truth: SPEC.md positioning, ACCEPTANCE.md N1 rows, DECISIONS.md D-021, STATE.md continuation.
